title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East (Late Show) on 1970-01-02
lineage: SBD > MR > DAT (x) > CDR (x) > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Superb soundboard recording captures a high‑energy, late‑1970 show highlighted by an epic Dark Star, fiery St. Stephen, thunderous Eleven and soaring Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The partial early set delivers one of the most celebrated Dark Stars of the era, with layered spacey jams, a standout Eleven and a rapturous Lovelight that showcase Jerry’s melodic fire and Pigpen’s organ brilliance.  The soundboard source is praised for crystal‑clear cymbals, front‑center drums and an overall crisp mix, despite a brief hiss and a cut in St. Stephen due to the recording being incomplete.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 5) and repeated praise for both performance and audio quality indicate an exceptional show with excellent recording, offset only by its truncated nature.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, front‑forward cymbals and snare; superb mix and clarity. Minor hiss from tape source and a cut in St. Stephen noted, but overall no significant dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Partial early set presented as Dark Star → St. Stephen → Lovelight; despite being truncated, the flow remains powerful and cohesive.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers highlight Jerry’s beautiful, melodic playing late in Dark Star and his overall fire throughout the set.
band_member_comments.Keys: References to Tom Constanten’s organ presence on Dark Star and Pigpen’s rare organ solo during Lovelight are noted.
band_member_comments.Drums: Cymbals, snare and overall drum mix are praised as front‑and‑center and very clear.
